_readme: Every fact the website states about the shop lives in this one file.
Anything with "placeholder": true is a stand-in. The site shows it with a dashed orange underline and a TODO tag.
To make it real: type the real value, set "placeholder" to false, then run: npm run build
Run  grep -n '"placeholder": true' site.config.json  to list what is still missing.
name: The Lucky Locker

preview._note: true keeps the site out of search engines (noindex) and shows the sample-site strip. Set to false at launch.

timezone._note: IANA name used by the open/closed badge, e.g. America/New_York, America/Chicago, America/Denver, America/Los_Angeles.

hours._note: 24-hour times. Leave open and close as null for a closed day.

forms._note: Formspree endpoints, e.g. https://formspree.io/f/abcdwxyz. Until they are real, the forms show a preview message instead of sending.
